synccard.title: Sync with OneDrive
synccard.toggleHint: Your settings and layout follow you to your other PCs through your OneDrive folder. Where the notch sits stays on each PC.
synccard.noFolder: OneDrive was not found on this PC. Choose your OneDrive folder to turn on sync.
synccard.askTitle: OneDrive already has settings from another PC
synccard.askHint: Choose which settings to keep. A copy of the others is saved first, just in case.
synccard.backupSaved: A copy of the old settings is saved in {folder}.
synccard.backupFailed: Atap could not save a copy of the old settings, so nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
synccard.status.waiting: Waiting for OneDrive to download the latest settings.
synccard.status.newerFile: Another PC has a newer Atap. Update Atap on this PC to keep syncing.
synccard.status.damagedFile: The sync file in OneDrive cannot be read. Atap leaves it as it is.
synccard.status.cannotWrite: Atap could not save to the OneDrive folder. It tries again after your next change.
